mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Temperatures are currently 67 degrees with clear skies around Badger Ridge Middle School under a New Moon. Air quality is moderate tonight with an AQI of 53. While the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to clouds. Expect an overnight low of 64 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, the Common Council unanimously approved the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan following extensive community input. The long-range plan sets priorities for housing, infrastructure, and downtown development for decades to come. Additionally, the city maintained its Moody's Aa1 bond rating.

For local entertainment, enjoy live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow features yoga sessions at Insight Wellness, and look forward to local trivia and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market coming up later this week.

In the weekly police report, on Saturday, officers acted on information regarding a stolen firearm case. An officer stopped a vehicle for expired registration, successfully recovered the stolen handgun, and arrested a nineteen-year-old Verona man.
Culver's is now closed for the night after serving up Caramel Cashew. Look forward to tomorrow's flavor of the day, Georgia Peach, when doors reopen at 10:00 AM.
